name: Bacalar
summary: Bacalar is a small town on a freshwater lagoon that shifts through seven shades of blue. Sail or paddle the lagoon to the Pirates' Channel and cenotes, see the stromatolites, float in Cenote Azul and visit the old Spanish fort.
seasonNote: Dry December to April; sargassum doesn't reach the lagoon.
arrival: About 4 hours by bus or car from Tulum, or 30 minutes from Chetumal airport.
cashTip: Carry pesos for markets, taxis and small places; cards work in larger restaurants. Tip 10 to 15 percent.
